## Analyzers (2)

### XposedOrNot_BreachAnalytics `v1.0`
Detailed XposedOrNot breach analytics for an email address: per-breach detail (date, records, exposed data classes, password-storage risk), first/latest exposure and overall risk. Free, no API key required.

- **Author:** XposedOrNot
- **License:** AGPL-V3
- **Data Types:** `mail`
- **Configuration:** [View config](https://github.com/TheHive-Project/Cortex-Analyzers/blob/master/analyzers/XposedOrNot/XposedOrNot_BreachAnalytics.json)

### XposedOrNot_CheckEmail `v1.0`
Fast check of an email address against the XposedOrNot data-breach database. Returns the list of breaches the address appears in. Free, no API key required.

- **Author:** XposedOrNot
- **License:** AGPL-V3
- **Data Types:** `mail`
- **Configuration:** [View config](https://github.com/TheHive-Project/Cortex-Analyzers/blob/master/analyzers/XposedOrNot/XposedOrNot_CheckEmail.json)
